summary: Pass exact PR range to Wellman governance gates

delivery.outcome: Both CI governance workflows validate the exact PR base/head on detached checkouts; regression coverage preserves no-PR and integrity rejection behavior. Publish through independent review and protected merge.
nonGoals: Change policy or permanent WIP limits
Modify ticket-270 or its reserved paths
Relax integrity, approval or merge checks
Release or adopter re-pin before source integration

architecture.decision: Pass one validated optional base/head pair to every governance invocation; validate the behavior with real Git history and the installed runtime.
architecture.rollback: Revert the workflow change through a reviewed corrective change.

validation.evidence: Detached checkout regression runs the workflow body against installed Wellman; both gates receive the same exact range.
No-PR behavior remains available, incomplete pairs fail closed, and managed drift is rejected.
